\[
F (t; \alpha (\beta), \beta , \eta (\beta)) = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} 1 - \mathrm {e} ^ {- \ln \left(\frac {1}{1 - \bar {y} _ {t _ {k}}}\right) \left(\frac {t - t _ {k} + K (\beta) (\tau_ {l} - t _ {k})}{\tau_ {l} - t _ {k} + K (\beta) (\tau_ {l} - t _ {k})}\right) ^ {\beta}}, & t > t _ {k} - K (\beta) (\tau_ {l} - t _ {k}) \\ 0, & t \leq t _ {k} - K (\beta) (\tau_ {l} - t _ {k}). \end{array} \right.
